structured.answer: Didn't put money anywhere yet, but now I get it: there's where the money sits (bank, קרן השתלמות, trading account) and what it's in (cash, קרן כספית, S&P). For my 30k I'd look at the S&P 500 index through a חשבון ניירות ערך, and a קרן כספית for money I might need. Nothing on the page says what fees cost or what to do first.
